title: Campaign Checklist: Permanent Rewards You Cannot Miss
summary: Every one-time permanent reward in the Path of Exile 2 campaign (Acts 1-3 and Cruel): skill points, Spirit, resistances, Life, and Weapon Set Points, with the exact optional bosses and side quests that grant them.
description: A filterable checklist of all permanent campaign rewards in Path of Exile 2, where each comes from, and how to recover a missed one in Cruel difficulty.
prerequisites: A character that has reached Acts 1-3 on Normal difficulty
Willingness to detour to optional bosses and accept side quests before finishing an act
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

items.title: What are permanent rewards?
body: Permanent rewards are one-time character bonuses granted by optional bosses and side quests across Acts 1-3: passive skill points, +Spirit, resistances, maximum Life, and Weapon Set Passive Points. They are applied to your character for the rest of the league, not just the session.

items.title: Why can't I miss them?
body: Most are tied to optional bosses or side quests you can skip on the critical path. Once you finish an act and move on, that specific drop or quest reward is gone for the Normal run. The only second chance is Cruel difficulty, which repeats most of them with small variations.

items.title: Biggest must-do list
body: Crowbell and King in the Mists in Act 1; Kabala, Tradition's Toll, and Doryani's Altar in Act 2; Mighty Silverfist, Ignagduk, the Corpse-snake Venom choice, and the Sacrificial Heart ritual in Act 3. These cover all Spirit, Life, and Weapon Set Point sources.

sections.title: Reward route by act
sections.intro: Follow the tab for your current act. Each lists the detours to make before you complete the act's final boss.

tabs.label: Act 1
paragraphs: Act 1 is where most players lose their first permanent rewards by rushing the main story.
bullets: Clear Hunting Grounds fully and kill The Crowbell for a Book of Specialization.
Enter Freythorn and defeat King in the Mists for +30 Spirit before leaving the zone.
In Ogham Farmlands, accept and finish The Lost Lute (Una's Lute) side quest for +2 skill points, and talk to Rynsa to unlock the Salvage Bench.
In Ogham Manor, kill Candlemass for +20 Maximum Life.

tabs.label: Act 2
paragraphs: Act 2 rewards are split between Keth and Deshar.
bullets: In Keth, kill Kabala, the Constrictor Queen for a Book of Specialization, and use Doryani's Altar of Sacrifice for +2 skill points.
In Deshar, complete Tradition's Toll for +2 Weapon Set Passive Points and grab the Sisters of Garukhan reward for +10% Lightning Resistance.
In the Valley of the Titans, decide between Charm Charges and Mana Recovery from Flasks based on your build.

tabs.label: Act 3
paragraphs: Act 3 has the densest cluster of permanent bonuses.
bullets: In Jungle Ruins, kill Mighty Silverfist for a Book of Specialization.
In The Azak Bog, defeat Ignagduk for +30 Spirit, and in The Venom Crypts take the Corpse-snake Venom choice that fits your defenses.
In Jiquani's Machinarium, kill Blackjaw for +10% Fire Resistance.
In Aggorat, collect the Sacrificial Heart from Vaal Goliaths, then use the ritual site for +2 Weapon Set Passive Points.

tabs.label: Cruel difficulty
paragraphs: Cruel repeats Acts 1-3 with a fresh set of rewards. It is your only recovery window for anything skipped on Normal.
bullets: Every Normal source above repeats in Cruel and grants a second copy.
Cruel-exclusive variations: Candlemass gives +5% max Life, Ignagduk gives +40 Spirit, and the Corpse-snake Venom choice adds a Chaos Resistance option.
Plan Cruel specifically as a 'cleanup' run if you missed several Normal rewards.

sections.title: Which reward did you miss?
sections.intro: Pick the bonus you are short on and the act you are in. The tool points you to the exact source.

rules.title: Get Spirit from King in the Mists or Ignagduk
steps: Return to Freythorn and defeat King in the Mists for +30 Spirit.
If Freythorn is gone, you must reach The Azak Bog in Act 3 for Ignagduk's +30 Spirit, or wait for Cruel.

rules.title: Get Weapon Set Points from a Book of Specialization
steps: Kill The Crowbell in Hunting Grounds for the first Book of Specialization.
Later sources: Kabala (Act 2), Tradition's Toll (Act 2), Mighty Silverfist (Act 3), Sacrificial Heart ritual (Act 3).

rules.title: Get passive skill points from side quests / altars
steps: Finish Tradition's Toll? No, that is Weapon Set Points. For skill points, do The Lost Lute in Act 1 or Doryani's Altar of Sacrifice in Keth.
In Cruel, both repeat for a second set.

rules.title: Pick up the missing resistance in its act
steps: Cold: Beira (Act 1). Lightning: Sisters of Garukhan (Act 2). Fire: Blackjaw (Act 3).
Cruel adds a Chaos Resistance option from the Corpse-snake Venom choice.

rules.title: Maximum Life comes from Candlemass
steps: Kill Candlemass in Ogham Manor for +20 Maximum Life.
In Cruel, Candlemass instead grants +5% increased Maximum Life.

defaultResult.title: You finished the act - recover it in Cruel
steps: Once an act is complete on Normal, its optional bosses and side quests are no longer accessible until Cruel difficulty.
On Cruel, replay Acts 1-3 and secure every source you missed; most grant a second copy with small variations.
If the reward was a one-time Cruel variation (Candlemass +5% Life, Ignagduk +40 Spirit), it cannot be recovered after Cruel.

entries.takeaway: Detour to optional bosses and accept side quests before finishing an act - most permanent rewards are missable on the critical path.

items.question: Can I get these rewards in the endgame?
answer: No. Campaign permanent rewards are granted once per character per difficulty. The endgame Atlas and maps do not re-grant them. If you missed one on Normal, your only recovery window is Cruel difficulty.

items.question: Do Weapon Set Passive Points count as passive skill points?
answer: No. A Book of Specialization converts two of your existing points into Weapon Set Points that only activate for the weapon set you allocate them to. They are refunded separately from The Hooded One or Doryani for gold.

items.question: What if I skipped an optional boss by accident?
answer: Re-enter the zone before you complete the act's final boss. After the act ends, that zone is locked until Cruel. Cruel repeats almost every source for a second set.

items.question: Are Cruel rewards identical to Normal?
answer: Mostly, with three variations: Candlemass gives +5% increased Maximum Life (instead of +20 flat), Ignagduk gives +40 Spirit (instead of +30), and the Corpse-snake Venom choice adds a Chaos Resistance option.
